root_cause.text: A deadlock occurs in the shadow stack signal frame pop operation because the kernel holds the mmap read lock while performing a userspace read access that may trigger a page fault, which recursively tries to acquire the same mmap read lock and can block if a writer is waiting.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and CVE description state that during sigreturn, the kernel reads the shadow stack signal frame while holding the mmap read lock; a page fault during that read causes the fault handler to attempt to reacquire the mmap read lock, leading to a deadlock when a writer is also waiting. The patch fixes this by dropping the mmap lock before the userspace access and using mmap_lock_speculate_...() to detect VMA changes.
